purpose: Find materially active or strategically important companies that are missing from registry/companies.json but should be linked to existing tracked themes or proposed for taxonomy review.

sources: important companies repeatedly appearing in tracked-theme industry evidence
scan_scope.candidate_rule: A missing company becomes a coverage-gap candidate when market relevance is meaningful and there is plausible linkage to a tracked theme. Price action alone is insufficient for auto-add.
scan_scope.resolution_rule: Add to registry only after verifying a material business/theme link. Otherwise keep open or dismiss with a reason.

resolved_gaps.name: 聯發科
resolved_gaps.reason: Material exposure to AI data-center custom ASIC/XPU and edge AI platforms was absent from the initial seed-based registry.

notes: The Theme Registry scheduler should update this file on every run. Open gaps are not automatically treated as tracked companies.
